name: Cafe GZI
kurzbeschreibung: Café GZI in Imst Welcome to Café GZI in the heart of Imst, where tradition meets modern charm.
beschreibung: The Cafe GZI in Imst in the Imst region is a charming café that delights its guests with homemade cakes, exquisite coffee specialties, and a cozy atmosphere. It is a wonderful place to relax, read a good book, or chat with friends. The menu offers a fine selection of traditional Austrian pastries – from creamy Sachertorte and light apple strudel to tempting Topfenstrudel (curd cheese strudel). In addition, aromatic coffee specialties prepared with great care are served. The inviting interior with comfortable seating and charming details creates a feel-good atmosphere.
